challenges: 超銀河ダイグレン / 超銀河グレンラガン: glossary 'Space Galaxy Dai-Gurren' / 'Space Galaxy Gurren Lagann' (akurasu Z3.2 Mech List) versus established English 'Super Galaxy Dai-Gurren' / 'Super Galaxy Gurren Lagann' (https://gurrenlagann.fandom.com/wiki/Super_Galaxy_Gurren_Lagann, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Gurren_Lagann_characters : 'Super Galaxy Dai-Gurren'; the fandom wiki gives 超銀河 = 'Super Galaxy' and Aniplex's releases use the same). The akurasu wiki wins by precedence, but 超 is 'Super' in the anime, and 超天元突破グレンラガン is written 'Super Tengen Toppa' in this file. The orchestrator decides.
uncertain: チミルフ: brief and Jigoku proposed 'Chimyulf'; no source found for it, every source found writes 'Thymilph'. Set to Thymilph; prose 'Chimiruf'/'Chimyulf' in Jigoku text must not be reused.

四天王: 'Four Heavenly Kings' follows Jigoku library English (precedence 4); Wikipedia and the fandom wiki write 'Four Supreme Generals' (precedence 5). Marked proposed. The prose token must absorb the Jigoku 'フォウ' + 'Heavenly Kings' split.
コレハナ島: the Japanese is コレハナ (ja.wikipedia); English Wikipedia writes 'Koreha Island'. Kept 'Korehana Island' (Jigoku and the Japanese spelling), proposed.
隔絶宇宙: no franchise term found; Jigoku 'Isolated Space' kept, written lower case; the fandom wiki says 'isolated universe'.

グレン団 / 大グレン団: 'Team Gurren' / 'Team Dai-Gurren' (Jigoku library mixes in 'Dai-Gurren Brigade'). Both spellings appear in licensed releases; Team Dai-Gurren chosen for consistency with 超銀河ダイグレン 'Dai-Gurren'.
ロージェノム・ヘッド and 螺旋王 are kept as separate pilot records for the same man as ロージェノム; profiles all say male.
Nicknames: 'Ron' for Leeron (Wikipedia), 'Forehead Boy' for Rossiu (fandom wiki), 'Kamina the Mighty' (fandom wiki) come from the TV series, not the game text.
Boota is recorded as male on the strength of the fandom wiki category; the game text does not say.
Leeron is recorded as male: the game DSCR only says his mannerisms are feminine (女性っぽい); ja.wikipedia (彼, オネエ言葉) and the fandom wiki (he) settle it.
